description: This Java source file defines the SdkState class, which manages the state of the Android SDK within the IDE, including loading SDK data asynchronously, tracking updates, and handling SDK sources and packages.

classes.name: SdkState
classes.description: Manages the state of the Android SDK, including loading SDK info asynchronously, tracking updates, and managing SDK sources and packages.

classes.name: IndicatorLogger
classes.description: Implements ILogger to log messages to a ProgressIndicator during SDK loading operations.

classes.name: LoadTask
classes.description: Background task to load SDK data, fetch sources, remote packages, and compute updates asynchronously.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton SdkState instance for given AndroidSdkData, caching instances with weak references.

methods.name: getSdkData
methods.description: Returns the AndroidSdkData associated with this SdkState.

methods.name: getLocalPkgInfos
methods.description: Returns the local SDK package information.

methods.name: getUpdates
methods.description: Returns the latest update result for the SDK.

methods.name: loadAsync
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous load of SDK data if not recently refreshed, with optional success/error callbacks.
